title: Fast Trainable Projection for Robust Fine-Tuning (FTP)
mechanism: Learns per-layer projection radii around pretrained weights via hyper-optimisation; AdamW plug-in.
evidence: Better OOD robustness on four vision tasks and five pretrained models; in SPD's PASCAL seg table FTP 73.79 ID / 58.45 OOD vs vanilla 66.03 / 44.00.
min_experiment: Run only if SPD wins: FTP vs SPD, seeds 5-9, same co-primaries. Kill if below SPD.
